title: EdgeConneX, Stockland strike JV deal to develop hyperscale data centres in Australia
key_facts: EdgeConneX entered the Australian market through a 50-50 joint venture with Stockland.
The venture plans to develop, own and operate hyperscale data center campuses across Australia, starting in Sydney and Melbourne.
It has 450 MW of power secured and is progressing more power applications and planning.
